findings_qualitative.value: No intervening extragalactic molecular absorbers detected; one intrinsic CO(1-0) absorber in J1415+1320 and multiple Galactic lines

evidence.quote: no extragalactic intervening molecular absorbers are detected

claims.hypothesis: Can a blind absorption survey constrain the molecular column density distribution beyond z~0?
claims.experiment: Search 28,644 ALMACAL spectra for CO absorption
claims.result: No intervening detections; Δz=182; N(H2)>1e16 probed
claims.finding: Upper limits on CDDF consistent with z=0 measurements and reach five orders of magnitude lower column density

evidence.quote: our limits at $0<z<0.5$ and $0.5 < z < 1.7$ are consistent with the column density distribution function measurement at $z = 0$

claims.experiment: Compare limits with TNG100 predicted CDDF
claims.result: Limits within about 1 dex of predictions at low column density
claims.finding: Already provide constraints but uncertainties are large

evidence.quote: our limits are already close, within  1 dex, of the expected value of $f(N(\text{H}_2), X)$ at low column densities

why_this_data.value: Large integration time and sky coverage of calibrators allow an unbiased, cosmic-variance-free search

evidence.quote: the total integration time spent on ALMACAL sources is $>1500$ hours, orders of magnitude more than what would be attainable in a targeted ALMA survey programme

limitations_admitted.value: Lensing magnification bias of background quasars remains a systematic issue

evidence.quote: the uncertainties introduced by lensing of the background quasar by the foreground absorber will remain a systematic issue

limitations_admitted.value: Conversion N(CO) to N(H2) is uncertain and not constant

evidence.quote: the column density ratio of $N({\rm CO})/ N(\mbox{H}_2)$ over a large range of H$_2$ column densities is not constant
